clusters.description:
Reading: Part(s).Belt -[is part of]-> LawnMower(s).Aggregate.

Belt end — role: Part, multiplicity 0..2
(a LawnMower may have no belt fitted at all — e.g. during maintenance (0),
one belt on a single-deck mower (1),
or two belts on a dual-deck mower (2).)

LawnMower end — role: Aggregate, multiplicity 0..1
(a Belt either belongs to exactly one LawnMower (1),
or exists independently — stored as a spare part in the barn (0).)

Aggregation semantics (hollow diamond):
The Belt exists independently of any LawnMower —
it may be a spare part in stock or a belt being replaced.
Destroying the LawnMower does not destroy the Belt.

Reading: Part(s).Blade -[is part of]-> LawnMower(s).Aggregate.

Blade end — role: Part, multiplicity 0..2
(a LawnMower may have no blade fitted — e.g. during servicing (0),
one blade on a single-deck mower (1),
or two blades on a dual-deck mower (2).)

LawnMower end — role: Aggregate, multiplicity 0..1
(a Blade either belongs to exactly one LawnMower (1),
or exists independently — stored as a replacement blade in the barn (0).)

Aggregation semantics (hollow diamond):
The Blade exists independently of any LawnMower —
it may be a spare blade in storage or a blade being sharpened.
Destroying the LawnMower does not destroy the Blade.
